from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Mapping

import pytest

from llm_router import (
    Model,
    NormalizedMessage,
    Provider,
    ProviderCredential,
    ProviderRequest,
    ProviderResult,
    ToolChoice,
)
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.tools import ToolRegistry

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _ToolStep:
    name: str
    arguments: Mapping[str, Any]
    output: Any


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _ToolLoopState:
    steps: tuple[_ToolStep, ...]
    round: int = 1


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _ToolCall:
    name: str
    arguments: Mapping[str, Any]
    id: str


def _dummy_add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_MULTI_ROUND_TOOL_EXECUTION[revision==1]")
def test_tool_limit_reached_returns_response_with_trace() -> None:
    executor = getattr(
        getattr(getattr(__import__("llm_router"), "_internal"), "runtime"),
        "executor",
    )
    _advance_tool_result = executor._advance_tool_result
    _ExecutionPlan = executor._ExecutionPlan
    _ExecutionLoopState = executor._ExecutionLoopState

    registry = ToolRegistry.from_tools([_dummy_add])
    tool_call = _ToolCall(name="_dummy_add", arguments={"a": 1, "b": 2}, id="call_1")

    credential = ProviderCredential(
        key_id=1,
        env_var="VALUE_VAR",
        value="test_value",
    )
    provider_request = ProviderRequest(
        request_id="req_test_123",
        provider=Provider.OPENROUTER,
        model=Model.DEEPSEEK_V3,
        provider_model="deepseek/deepseek-chat",
        credential=credential,
        messages=(NormalizedMessage(role="user", parts=(), meta={}),),
        tool_registry=registry,
        tool_choice=ToolChoice(kind="auto"),
    )

    plan = _ExecutionPlan(
        schema=None,
        tool_registry=registry,
        tool_choice=ToolChoice(kind="auto"),
        max_tool_rounds=1,
    )

    prior_step = _ToolStep(
        name="_dummy_add",
        arguments={"a": 1, "b": 2},
        output=3,
    )
    initial_tool_state = _ToolLoopState(
        steps=(prior_step,),
        round=1,
    )
    state = _ExecutionLoopState(
        messages=(),
        tool_state=initial_tool_state,
        tool_choice=ToolChoice(kind="auto"),
        tool_registry=registry,
        schema=None,
        structured_attempts=0,
    )

    result = ProviderResult(
        data={"id": "resp_test"},
        provider=Provider.OPENROUTER,
        model=Model.DEEPSEEK_V3,
        provider_model="deepseek/deepseek-chat",
        output_text="asking for another tool",
        tool_calls=(tool_call,),
    )

    step = _advance_tool_result(
        provider_request=provider_request,
        plan=plan,
        state=state,
        result=result,
    )

    assert step is not None
    assert step.response is not None
    assert step.response.output_text == ""
    assert step.response.tool_calls == result.tool_calls
    assert len(step.response.tool_trace) >= 1
